author: Grow Channels
title: 3 Claude Prompts to Grow a YouTube Channel
one_liner: Use Claude AI with 3 specific prompts to find niches, analyze competitors, and generate viral YouTube video ideas.
key_points: Find a niche using NexLev: target competitors under 100k subs but pulling 500k+ views/month
Prompt #1 (Channel Forensics): assign Claude the role of Elite YouTube Title Strategist to reverse-engineer viral patterns
Prompt #2 (Competitor Research): feed Claude a PDF channel blueprint with view counts and title data for deep analysis
Prompt #3 (Viral Video Ideas): provide Claude two documents — channel blueprint + top video analysis — to generate new high-potential video concepts
